blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) on Monday filed an agricultural economic sabotage complaint against thirteen individuals allegedly involved in smuggling cigarettes worth P13 billion. READ: BOC seizes over P1.17-B suspected smuggled cigarettes in Cebu port According to NBI Director Melvin Matibag, the case stems from the 59 container vans seized by the agency from various ports in June. “What is peculiar in this case is that hindi ito katulad ng mga kasong mga driver o pahinante lang ang kinakasuhan natin, we are filing charges against at least 13 individuals, sinama natin ‘yung port operator ng private port […]...
